claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says Sophia was born aboard a fast-moving starship in hyperspace, away from planets, to limit collective-perception influences.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Mari says her mother and grandmother minimized planetary exposure during gestation.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says Sophia remembers at least twelve past incarnations and can pass through solid walls by treating her body as spirit.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Mari presents these as Sophia's reported abilities and understanding.
